test_info.title: IELTS Diagnostic Placement Test
test_info.description: Comprehensive 15-question diagnostic test evaluating Reading, Listening, and Academic Grammar to determine starting CEFR level and IELTS Band prediction.

passage.title: The Rise of Autonomous Urban Micro-Mobility
passage.content: In recent years, metropolitan transport networks have experienced a paradigm shift driven by autonomous micro-mobility solutions. Electric scooters and light autonomous pods are increasingly deployed across European cities to mitigate inner-city traffic congestion and decrease carbon emissions. Critics argue that insufficient infrastructure, such as dedicated lanes and regulated parking zones, poses safety hazards for pedestrians. However, preliminary empirical studies conducted in Copenhagen demonstrate a 14% reduction in peak-hour vehicle traffic following the integration of geo-fenced micro-mobility lanes. Urban planners emphasize that for these initiatives to succeed long-term, municipal governance must enforce strict speed limits, mandate helmet usage, and integrate public transit fares into unified digital ticketing systems. Furthermore, advances in solid-state battery technology promise to extend vehicle operation ranges by 40%, making micro-mobility a viable competitor to short-distance urban rail transit.

questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of deploying autonomous micro-mobility solutions in metropolitan areas?
options: To replace high-speed regional rail systems
To alleviate urban traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions
To generate revenue through parking fines
questions.correct_answer: To alleviate urban traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions
questions.explanation: The text states that electric scooters and autonomous pods are deployed 'to mitigate inner-city traffic congestion and decrease carbon emissions'.

questions.question_text: Empirical studies in Copenhagen proved that pedestrians experienced fewer accidents after micro-mobility lanes were built.
questions.explanation: The passage mentions a 14% reduction in peak-hour vehicle traffic in Copenhagen, but does not state whether pedestrian accident rates decreased.

questions.question_text: Urban planners consider unified ticketing systems essential for the long-term success of micro-mobility initiatives.
questions.explanation: The text highlights that urban planners emphasize integrating public transit fares into unified digital ticketing systems for long-term success.

questions.question_text: According to the passage, what technological advancement will increase the operating range of micro-mobility vehicles?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly notes that 'advances in solid-state battery technology promise to extend vehicle operation ranges by 40%'.

questions.question_text: Which heading best summarizes the main focus of the passage?
options: The History of Municipal Rail Transit
Challenges and Potential of Autonomous Micro-Mobility in Modern Cities
questions.correct_answer: Challenges and Potential of Autonomous Micro-Mobility in Modern Cities
questions.explanation: The passage discusses both benefits (reducing congestion/emissions) and challenges (infrastructure, safety regulations) of autonomous urban micro-mobility.

transcript.title: University Library Membership Enrolment
transcript.text:
Assistant: Good morning, welcome to the St. Jude University Library. How can I help you today?
Student: Hello! I'd like to apply for a postgraduate student membership card.
Assistant: Certainly. I'll just take your details. Could I have your full name, please?
Student: Yes, it's Julian Vance. That's V-A-N-C-E.
Assistant: Great. And your university registration number?
Student: It's PG-884029.
Assistant: Thank you. Which faculty are you enrolled in?
Student: Environmental Science. My specialization is Renewable Energy Systems.
Assistant: Excellent. For postgraduate members, the standard borrowing limit is 12 books at any one time, for up to 30 days. However, reference journals must remain inside the quiet reading room on Floor 3.
Student: Understood. Is there a fee for reserving research articles online?
Student: No, online reservations are completely free. However, late returns incur a fine of 50 pence per day per item.
Assistant: Got it. Thank you very much!

questions.explanation: The student spells out his surname: V-A-N-C-E.
The student provides the registration code PG-884029.
The student states he is in Environmental Science.

questions.question_text: Maximum borrowing allowance for postgraduates: ____ books
questions.explanation: The assistant confirms the borrowing limit is 12 books.

questions.question_text: Location of reference journals: Quiet Reading Room on Floor ____
questions.explanation: The assistant mentions reference journals are on Floor 3.

questions.question_text: Had the municipal council invested in flood defenses earlier, the severity of the damage ____ significantly reduced.
questions.explanation: Inverted third conditional structure: 'Had + Subject + Past Participle ..., Subject + would have + Past Participle'.

questions.question_text: The research committee demanded that the thesis ____ resubmitted before the end of the academic term.
questions.explanation: Subjunctive mood structure following verbs of recommendation/demand ('demanded that + subject + base verb').

questions.question_text: Modern telecommunication networks, ____ rely heavily on subsea fiber-optic cables, transfer petabytes of data daily.
questions.explanation: Non-defining relative clause adding extra information about a non-human antecedent requires 'which' preceded by a comma.

questions.question_text: Rarely ____ such a swift economic recovery during a global supply chain crisis.
questions.explanation: Negative adverbial inversion: 'Rarely + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb'.

questions.question_text: By the time the new environmental legislation takes effect next year, carbon emissions ____ by 15%.
questions.explanation: Future Perfect tense is used for an action that will be completed before a specified point in the future ('By the time...').
